title: Impulse buying
scenario: A flash sale pops up and you buy headphones you had not planned for.
fix: Wait 24 hours before any non-essential purchase over a set amount.

title: Ignoring small expenses
scenario: Daily snacks and small transport top-ups feel too small to track.
fix: Log every expense for one week — small spends add up fast when totaled.

title: Paying late
scenario: Hostel fees or a phone bill slip past the due date and attract a penalty.
fix: Set a reminder three days before each due date, not on the day itself.

title: Unused subscriptions
scenario: A streaming trial auto-renews months after you stopped watching.
fix: Review every active subscription once a month and cancel what you don't use.

title: Spending without a plan
scenario: Allowance arrives and disappears within days with nothing to show for it.
fix: Assign every naira a job before you spend — even a rough plan beats none.
